title: 🔥 DID JESUS REALLY CLAIM TO BE GOD? YES, AND HERE’S THE PROOF! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DID JESUS REALLY CLAIM TO BE GOD? YES, AND HERE’S THE PROOF! 🚨🔥
📖 John 10:30 – "I and the Father are one."
🚨 Many false teachers, cults, and skeptics say, “Jesus never claimed to be God.” But the Bible tells a different story!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Jesus was just a prophet, a teacher, or a good man!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word WAS GOD!" (John 1:1)
👉 IF JESUS NEVER CLAIMED TO BE GOD, WHY DID THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WANT HIM KILLED? READ THIS BEFORE YOU FALL FOR THE LIE!

🔥 1. JESUS CLAIMED TO BE GOD—AND THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS KNEW IT!
📖 John 10:33 – "We are not stoning you for any good work," they replied, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, CLAIM TO BE GOD!"

🔥 WHAT JESUS SAID VS. HOW PEOPLE REACTED:
✔️ Jesus said, "I and the Father are one." (John 10:30)
✔️ The Jews IMMEDIATELY picked up stones to kill Him for blasphemy!
🚨 IF JESUS WAS JUST CLAIMING TO BE A PROPHET, WHY DID THEY WANT HIM DEAD?

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine someone in a courtroom saying, "I am the President of the United States!" If it were a joke, people would laugh. But if they were SERIOUS, they would be arrested for impersonation!
📖 John 8:58 – "Before Abraham was born, I AM!"
👉 JESUS USED THE SAME NAME GOD USED FOR HIMSELF IN EXODUS 3:14—"I AM THAT I AM!"

🔥 2. JESUS ACCEPTED WORSHIP—AND ONLY GOD CAN BE WORSHIPED!
📖 Matthew 14:33 – "Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, ‘Truly you are the Son of God!’"

🔥 BIBLICAL TRUTH:
✔️ Angels REFUSED worship! (Revelation 22:8-9 – "Do not worship me! Worship God!")
✔️ The apostles REFUSED worship! (Acts 10:25-26 – "Stand up! I am only a man myself!")
✔️ But Jesus ACCEPTED worship—because He IS God!
🚨 IF JESUS WASN’T GOD, HE WOULD HAVE REBUKED PEOPLE FOR WORSHIPING HIM!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If someone bowed before a true man of God, that preacher would IMMEDIATELY tell them, "Get up! Worship God alone!" But Jesus never stopped people from worshiping Him.
📖 John 20:28 – "Thomas said to Him, ‘My Lord and my God!’"
👉 THOMAS CALLED JESUS "GOD"—AND JESUS DIDN’T CORRECT HIM!

🔥 3. JESUS CLAIMED TO FORGIVE SINS—SOMETHING ONLY GOD CAN DO!
📖 Mark 2:5-7 – "When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralyzed man, ‘Son, your sins are forgiven.’ The teachers of the law thought, ‘Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?’"

🔥 THINK ABOUT IT:
✔️ If someone steals your car, can I forgive them? NO! Only YOU can forgive them!
✔️ Jesus forgave sins—because He is the One we sin against!
🚨 THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS KNEW THIS MEANT JESUS WAS CLAIMING TO BE GOD!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a judge in court saying, "I forgive all criminals in this city!" The world would say, "Who do you think you are? Only the law can do that!"
📖 Isaiah 43:25 – "I, even I, am He who blots out your transgressions."
👉 JESUS DID WHAT ONLY GOD CAN DO—FORGIVE SINS!

🔥 4. THE DISCIPLES AND APOSTLES PREACHED THAT JESUS IS GOD!
📖 Colossians 2:9 – "For in Christ all the fullness of Deity lives in bodily form."

🔥 DID THE EARLY CHRISTIANS BELIEVE JESUS WAS GOD? YES!
✔️ John 1:1 – "The Word was God."
✔️ Titus 2:13 – "Jesus Christ, our great God and Savior."
✔️ Hebrews 1:8 – "But about the Son He says, ‘Your throne, O GOD, will last forever and ever!’"
🚨 IF JESUS WAS JUST A PROPHET, WHY DID THE APOSTLES PREACH THAT HE WAS GOD?

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A false teacher once said, "Jesus never claimed to be God!" But when shown these verses, he had no answer—because the Bible is CLEAR!
📖 Philippians 2:6 – "Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be used to His own advantage."
👉 JESUS WAS FULLY GOD AND FULLY MAN!

🔥 5. IF JESUS ISN’T GOD, THEN HE DIED FOR NOTHING!
📖 1 John 2:2 – "He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world."

🔥 WHY DOES THIS MATTER?
✔️ If Jesus was just a man, His death would mean NOTHING!
✔️ Only God’s blood can pay for the sins of the world!
✔️ If Jesus wasn’t God, then Christianity is a LIE!
🚨 BUT JESUS CONQUERED DEATH AND PROVED HE IS GOD!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Buddha is dead. Muhammad is dead. Every religious leader is dead. BUT JESUS ROSE FROM THE DEAD—BECAUSE HE IS GOD!
📖 Revelation 1:17-18 – "I am the First and the Last. I was dead, and now look, I am alive forever and ever!"
👉 ONLY GOD HAS POWER OVER LIFE AND DEATH!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: YOU MUST CHOOSE—IS JESUS GOD OR JUST A MAN?
📖 John 8:24 – "If you do not believe that I AM, you will die in your sins."

🔥 THERE ARE ONLY THREE OPTIONS:
❌ 1. Jesus was a liar. (Impossible—His words have changed the world!)
❌ 2. Jesus was insane. (Impossible—His wisdom surpasses all men!)
✅ 3. Jesus is LORD! (The ONLY truth that makes sense!)
🚨 WHAT YOU BELIEVE ABOUT JESUS DETERMINES YOUR ETERNITY!

🔥 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
You have two choices:
✔️ Believe Jesus is God, repent, and be saved!
❌ Reject the truth and face judgment!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I believe You are God! I repent of my sins and surrender my life to You. Be my Lord and Savior. Open my eyes to Your truth! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥
